title: A Pin in the Nap Mat
lines: Nan and Nat pat a tan nap mat.
A pin is in the mat!
Tip it, Nan. Tip the mat.
The pin is in a pin tin.

questions.ask: What did Nan and Nat find in the mat?
questions.listenFor: A pin. Line two says it, and the exclamation mark is the clue that it was a surprise.
Into a pin tin. Line four says it. If they say "the mat," have them read that line again.

questions.ask: Find the line that tells you the pin is out of the mat. Read it to me.
questions.listenFor: Line four — the pin is in a pin tin. Let them hunt for it rather than reading it for them.
